messages.content: You are the same MAIN programmer. Implement the public contract and actual owner decisions in executable statements. Use your notes as a working sketch and resolve any disagreement in favor of the exact original wording. Trace the first return for each relevant condition. Preserve separately confirmed general behavior and exception precedence. Do not pick arbitrary values, tie-breaks, or inclusive bounds. If missing policy would change an outcome, abstain only on that path. Prefer editing the named function body. For a body target the function declaration and base indentation are provided by the editor. Write only its body. Each item is one physical source line, depth 0 at the top of the selected region, depth 1 one level inside it. Put no leading spaces or newlines in code. Cite the source IDs on the actual predicate, selection or return implementing them. Keep code short. Do not add explanatory docstrings, comments, sample calls or tests. Set complete only if all required decisions are settled.
